5.13
Embedding Engine
After chunk generation, every chunk is converted into a dense numerical vector.
The implementation uses the Sentence Transformers library with the all-MiniLM-L6-v2
embedding model.
Major implementation features include:
• Lazy model loading
• Singleton model architecture
• Batch embedding generation
• Embedding normalization
• 384-dimensional vectors
Embedding normalization converts vectors into unit vectors, enabling cosine similarity
computation using the FAISS Inner Product index.
The embedding engine also supports batch processing, reducing indexing time for
large document collections.
5.14
Vector Database Implementation
The generated embedding vectors are stored inside a FAISS vector database.
Each workspace maintains an independent vector index, preventing interference be-
tween different research projects.
The implementation includes:
• Persistent FAISS index
• Workspace-wise isolation
• Incremental indexing
• Similarity search
• Vector deletion
